newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bank Qld shares sparked by dividend.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bank Qld shares sparked by dividend.

text.p: Shares in regional bank, the Bank of Queensland Ltd, jumped 59 cents to a record high of A$6.10 on Monday following Friday's announcement of a special dividend of 65 cents per share, payable on July 1.
The sharp rise came despite a warning that its half year profit for the six months ending February 28 was likely to be about 25 percent below the year-ago result.
"Friday's announcement was a mixed blesssing but obviously the dividend is very attractive," said a Sydney broker.
The bank said its profit for the second half of the financial year was expected to be above that for the first half, but still below the previous corresponding period.
Bank of Queensland reported a net profit for the first half of 1995/96 of A$10.21 million and an operating profit of A$17.81 million.
By 2.40 p.m. (0340 GMT), Bank of Queensland shares had eased from their highs to be up 42 cents on the day at A$5.93 on turnover of 148,018 shares.
